senses.gloss: ग (I) a. (f. गा) (used only at the end of compounds) Going, moving, entering, being, remaining, having sexual intercourse with &c. M.ii.62, viii.386, R.iii.13.
ग (II) m. 1. A Gandharva; 2. an epithet of Gaṇeśa; 3. a long syllabic (used as an abbreviation of गुरु) (in prosody).
ग (I) a. (f. गा) (used only at the end of compounds) Going, moving, entering, being, remaining, having sexual intercourse with &c. M.ii.62, viii.386, R.iii.13.
गा f. A song, a verse.
